status: frozen_before_new_candidate_scores; retrospective development, not prospective preregistration
training_rule: forecast vintage < prediction vintage AND outcome year <= prediction vintage; annual SRA was published before that year's LTRA
selection_before_sufficient_inner_data: anchored_components when fitting is supported, otherwise common_reference_persistence
fit_objective: component-wise weighted absolute error / origin net demand * 100, with inverse repeated-region-target weights
selection_objective: weighted absolute balance error / origin net demand * 100 on resolved inner rolling-origin predictions; all use the forecast-source RML
candidate_acceptance: Both primary MAEs improve over both persistence baselines on the fitted-origin panel; leave-one-region/vintage-out summaries do not reverse either improvement; regional and vintage cluster intervals exclude zero for both primary improvements. This is a retrospective evidence gate, not independent validation or automatic physical-ledger approval.
outcome: Later SRA summer planning-assessment quantities, not independently observed accredited capacity or reliability events
meaning: Calibrated evolution of source-native planning demand/resources/response, not physical project-delivery probabilities
annual_application: 2025 information vintage; coefficients fitted using outcomes through 2025 only; 2026-2035 inputs are LTRA2025; leads 6-10 remain unvalidated scenario transport
california: One matched 2025->2026 extension, never included in fitting; pooled-coefficient transport is unvalidated
preservation: Write only in calibrated_reference_20261004; do not overwrite old results, manuscripts or figures
